description: Admin only. Decide which ROWS of a table a role may see or change. modes: all | own (rows where the person is in one of owner_columns, e.g. owner_id, created_by) | assigned (rows the person is linked to via set_record_members) | assigned_via (the person is linked to the PARENT record: field = the reference column, parent_resource = the parent table, e.g. lab orders via project_id to mod_asbest_projects) | field_equals (row field = a field of the person's profile) | none. Several rules for one role are OR-ed. A table with rules but none for a given role leaves that role unrestricted. applies_to: read | write | all. Pass rule_id + remove=true to delete a rule. Read 'scope' before relying on it.

applies_to.description: read | create | update | delete, or write (= create+update+delete), or all.

field.description: For field_equals: column of the table. For assigned_via: the reference column (e.g. project_id).

mode.description: Which rows the role may see or change

parent_resource.description: For assigned_via: the parent table whose assignments count.

remove.description: true with rule_id deletes the rule

resource.description: Table the row rule applies to

name: set_row_rule
